text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000096 bills 99215 well above expected in every complexity band, including low-acuity visits, but the few charts returned all support the billed level, so the evidence is mixed.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The 99215 share runs above the all-provider rate in every complexity band, not just among multi-morbid patients, which a sicker panel alone would not explain. Sampled low-complexity 99215s carry low-acuity diagnoses, such as rash on C0049347, upper respiratory infection on C0049666, follow-up on C0049758 and abdominal pain on C0049181, and that pattern is consistent with upcoding. Against this, every documented 99215 (for example C0049728 and C0049818) shows high MDM with substantial minutes. However, only 6 documented 99215s against nearly 300 billed is too thin to clear the pattern. The two moderate-plus data-reviewed notes with no lab or test line are weak evidence of templated or inflated notes, not proof. The reviewer should first request charts targeted at the low-complexity 99215s listed here, checking whether the notes are cloned or templated, and should also review why 99214 dominates the overall code mix."}
